upcoming_events.title: Seeing Red Wine Festival
upcoming_events.description: Four days in Seaside: the Bud & Alley's vintners dinner Thursday, the Al Fresco Reserve Tasting on the Lyceum lawn Friday evening, Saturday's Battle of the Sommeliers and Grand Tasting across Central Square and Ruskin Place, and a Celebration of Bubbles brunch Sunday morning · benefits DCWAF · weekend passes are waitlisted, single-day tickets at seasideseeingred.com · 5-min walk or drive.

upcoming_events.title: WaterColor Mountainfilm on Tour
upcoming_events.description: 26th year of the tour · two nights of award-winning documentary shorts on adventure, environment and culture, straight from the Mountainfilm festival in Telluride, outdoors at the Marina Park Amphitheater · gates 5:45 PM, films at 7 PM · 10-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Baytowne Tribute Weekend
upcoming_events.description: Two free nights of tribute bands on the Events Plaza Lawn, 7–9 PM — Pandora's Box Friday, The 77 Experience Saturday · bring a blanket or lawn chairs · 25-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Alys Beach Crafted
upcoming_events.description: Five days of craft and culinary events — a songwriters session at Caliza, experiential dinners, the 6th annual Firkin Fête, the Spirited Soirée cocktail tasting, and the Holiday Makers Market each afternoon · benefits the Cultural Arts Alliance of Walton County · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Rosemary Beach Uncorked
upcoming_events.description: 15th annual · Saturday Nov 14, 2026, 1–4 PM on Barrett Square · wines poured by vintners from around the world alongside dishes from ten Rosemary Beach restaurants, with live music as you stroll the cobblestone streets · $225 general admission, $350 VIP · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Turn On The Town
upcoming_events.description: Saturday Nov 28, 2026 — the holiday parade steps off from Seagrove Plaza at 3 PM and ends in Central Square, where Santa lights the town tree at 5 PM in the Amphitheater · free to attend · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Central Square Cinema
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 30 · Fri 8 PM · Free family movies on the big screen at the Seaside Amphitheater, Fridays at 8 PM through Oct 30, closing the season with a Halloween-themed show · bring a blanket and the kids · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Morning Vinyasa Yoga
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 31 · Daily 8:30 AM · Every morning at 8:30 AM on the pavilion overlooking the Gulf, weather permitting · no preregistration, $25 drop-in by cash, check, or Venmo · bring a mat or towel and water · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seaside Farmers Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sat 9–1 · Saturdays year-round, 9 AM–1 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater, with a second Tuesday market added each June and July · local growers, artisan cheeses and breads, craft chefs, and live acoustic music · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: 30A Farmers' Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sun 9–1 · About 30 vendors on Barrett Square every Sunday, 9 AM–1 PM — local produce and micro-greens, Gulf seafood off the boat, artisan breads and sweets, grass-fed beef, tupelo honey · pet-friendly · a great Sunday-morning outing · 15-min drive east
